name: PhotoFix
tagline: Batch-polishes real estate listing photos straight from a dropped folder
description: Drop a folder of property shots and it edits the whole set in one pass, with the brightening and straightening listing photos need. Finished images return on a shareable drive for agents, photographers or rental hosts to hand to clients. Built by a drone crew that wanted less desk time.
author: MarsHomestead
